subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider after Google’s Vertex AI branding moved under Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The source confirms visible stale copy, but the issue’s requested replacement wording differs from current official Google wording and a broad provider-id rename would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave the visible label unchanged until Google’s docs, APIs, and OpenClaw product copy settle on a shorter replacement.

options.title: Use Short Gemini Enterprise Copy
options.body: Adopt a shorter UI label such as `Gemini Enterprise` and document that it maps to the existing Vertex API and ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update labels and docs to the current Google wording while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing signal from current label blame and adjacent Google provider onboarding work.
